codegate.dependency.Evaluate/outcome/eva.purpose: `codegate.dependency.Evaluate` answers `evaluated` for an input no other branch's guard claims

codegate.dependency/authored/canonical-o.purpose: Input order cannot change sorted units, findings or metrics.

codegate.dependency/authored/complete-em.purpose: A complete empty observation is valid.

codegate.dependency/authored/complete-is.purpose: Complete isolated units have measured zero fan-out.

codegate.dependency/authored/configurati.purpose: Evidence for a different selected configuration is refused.

codegate.dependency/authored/dangling-so.purpose: A nonexistent source unit refuses the snapshot.

codegate.dependency/authored/dangling-ta.purpose: A nonexistent resolved target refuses the snapshot.

codegate.dependency/authored/dependency-.purpose: Build policy does not treat a runtime edge as build evidence.

codegate.dependency/authored/duplicate-e.purpose: Duplicate edge identity refuses the snapshot.

codegate.dependency/authored/duplicate-u.purpose: Duplicate unit identity refuses the snapshot.

codegate.dependency/authored/empty-ident.purpose: Empty unit identity refuses the snapshot.

codegate.dependency/authored/explicit-un.purpose: An unresolved destination remains partial rather than disappearing.

codegate.dependency/authored/failed-coll.purpose: Failed collection yields an error rather than measurements.

codegate.dependency/authored/forbidden-r.purpose: A witnessed forbidden edge fails with its evidence ID.

codegate.dependency/authored/go-facts-sa.purpose: Producer and source-language labels do not change semantics.

codegate.dependency/authored/invalid-pol.purpose: Forbidden rules must refer to the selected inventory.

codegate.dependency/authored/invalid-tar.purpose: Resolved and unresolved destinations are mutually exclusive.

codegate.dependency/authored/one-runtime.purpose: The shared metric counts a resolved runtime destination.

codegate.dependency/authored/parallel-im.purpose: Two edge occurrences to one destination count once.

codegate.dependency/authored/partial-is-.purpose: No observed edges under partial coverage is not measured zero.

codegate.dependency/authored/polyglot-no.purpose: Mixed language inventories do not invent interop relations.

codegate.dependency/authored/source-mism.purpose: Evidence for a different expected source is refused.

codegate.dependency/authored/unknown-ir-.purpose: Unknown mandatory fact semantics are refused.

codegate.dependency/authored/unresolved-.purpose: An unresolved destination contradicts complete dependency coverage.

codegate.dependency/authored/unsupported.purpose: Unsupported coverage cannot masquerade as successful empty analysis.
Unsupported coverage cannot carry contradictory dependency observations.

codegate.dependency/authored/witnessed-v.purpose: A witnessed violation fails while metric completeness remains unavailable.
